title: critoniopsis weberbaueri
intro: Critoniopsis weberbaueri, commonly known as the Peruvian critoniopsis, is a plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Andean medicine. The health benefits of Critoniopsis weberbaueri include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which are believed to contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Critoniopsis weberbaueri have been reported to include flavonoids, terpenes, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
